verdict.rationale: Render documents an official CLI for managing services and datastores from the terminal, including render.yaml Blueprint validation. It also offers a REST API with a live OpenAPI spec and push-triggered deploys, which together make scripted, headless automation plausible. However, nothing in the pack explicitly documents a non-interactive or CI mode, API-key authentication for pipelines, or official CI integrations, so the story is only partly evidenced. missing for 10: explicit headless/non-interactive CLI mode documentation, CI pipeline integration guides (e.g. GitHub Actions), token-based auth for CI, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
